title: Find duplicate files by comparing their checksums
summary: Computes a fingerprint (a SHA-256 checksum) of every file in a folder tree and lists the files whose fingerprints are the same. Equal fingerprints mean identical contents, even when the names differ. This card only lists duplicates and deletes nothing.

aliases.text: which files have the same content
find copies of the same file in a folder
найти одинаковые файлы по контрольной сумме
найти копии одного и того же файла в папке

steps.explain: Compute a checksum for every file under the folder, sort the lines so equal checksums sit together, then print every line whose first 64 characters (the checksum) occur more than once.
steps.expect: Lines with the same long hex string at the start, each followed by a file path. Files that share a checksum are identical.

steps.explain: Decide which copy to keep. This card does not delete anything. If you remove a copy later, check its path again first and use rm on that single file.

warnings: Every file is read in full, so large folders take a long time.
File names that contain a line break are not handled correctly by this pipeline.
